refs.why: Christ as the kept concept draws Him beside the accused: His head, face, hair, beard and robe, three-quarters toward the viewer's left
the kept frame of Him turned to the viewer: His front face
the kept concept's robe, sash and sandals: His dress only
His figure as the film's animation draws Him now, three-quarters: hold His face to it
His figure as the film's animation draws Him now, from the front: hold His face to it

poses.layout: Draw Him six times in one row, evenly spaced, each a pose the film's storyboard gives Him, left to right: one, standing at rest, turned three-quarters toward the viewer's left, looking down a little, both hands low; two, turned to face the viewer, holding one circle hand out at chest height with a small gold seed resting on it, the other hand low; three, turned three-quarters toward the viewer's left, His head bowed, His near arm in its sleeve, the hand raised a little in front of His chest, the far hand low; four, turned three-quarters toward the viewer's left, leaning a little, His near arm in its sleeve held out and down, the hand at hip height in front of Him, as over someone lying low before Him; five, stooped low and crouching, three-quarters toward the viewer's left, His head bowed, one circle hand resting on the ground in front of Him with a few faint marks in the dust beside it; six, gliding toward the viewer's left, three-quarters: both soles flat on the ground line, the feet close together, the body leaning a little into the travel, the robe's hem swung back.

heads.layout: Draw only His head and the top of His shoulders, six times in a row, evenly spaced, all the same size. One to three are turned three-quarters toward the viewer's left: one, level, at rest, a small warm smile; two, bowed, looking down, compassion, the inner ends of the brows raised; three, lifted a little, looking up, glad. Four to six face the viewer straight on: four, level, at rest, a small warm smile; five, bowed, looking down, grieved, the mouth turned a little down; six, lifted a little, speaking, the mouth a little open inside the beard.
